features.name: Contoso Coffee demo data framework
features.description: Microsoft's platform for building repeatable, versionable demo and initialization data in Business Central, structured around module codeunits that implement a standard interface with entry points for setup, master, transactional, and historical data.

features.name: Demo data module codeunit pattern
features.description: A consistent architectural pattern where each module is structured around a codeunit implementing the standard controls demo data module interface with four entry points: create setup data, create master data, create transactional data, and historical data.

features.name: Helper codeunit pattern for safe data insertion
features.description: Reusable helper codeunits that handle safe record insertion, including existence checking, override handling, validation, and modification logic, delegated from module codeunits to avoid direct data insertion.

features.name: Data codeunit pattern with literal values
features.description: Codeunits containing literal data values and label constants for primary keys, designed for recreating specific records consistently across demo environments.

features.name: Enum extension for module registration
features.description: An enum extension mechanism that registers modules with the demo data framework, connecting all components of the framework together.

features.name: Contoso Coffee manufacturing module
features.description: The initial Contoso Coffee module released in 2022 wave 1, focused on manufacturing scenarios with limited scope.

features.name: Contoso Coffee 2024 wave 2 expansion
features.description: Expansion of Contoso Coffee in 2024 wave 2 to include foundation, finance, CRM, bank, purchasing, and sales modules in a single release, establishing it as a genuine platform.

features.name: Rapid start configuration packages
features.description: Legacy method for bringing data into new Business Central companies using configuration packages in XML or Excel format, now superseded by the Contoso Coffee framework due to limitations in validation, static nature, and version control.

features.name: Demo Data Generator Tool
features.description: An open source tool that runs inside Business Central to automatically generate AL extension modules by reading existing data and converting it into properly structured demo data code units, helper code units, data code units, and enum extensions following established patterns.
caveats: Eliminates about 80 percent of boilerplate effort but the remaining 20 percent requires manual expertise
Only covers what is configured in the tool; does not automatically handle edge cases or custom logic
Data quality and cleanup is needed before use

features.name: Kontoso Framework
features.description: Microsoft's framework for demo data that provides clean, extensible patterns with consistent structure for module code units, helper code units, and data code units. Covers standard product functionality but does not include manufacturing, service management, or ISV verticals.
caveats: Does not cover manufacturing, service management, or ISV vertical modules

features.name: AI prompts for code readability
features.description: Two prompts included with the generator package to make procedure names and labels human-readable, allowing the AI agent to improve generated code legibility.

features.name: Transactional data placeholder generation
features.description: The generator creates placeholder code units with to-do comments for transactional data, providing JSON exports of historical records that can be used with AI prompts to recreate posted documents based on live database data.
caveats: Automatic generation of actual transactional data is not straightforward
Requires linking to Contoso libraries or internal demo data repositories for meaningful results

features.name: Manual edit preservation across regeneration
features.description: The tool tracks which code segments have been manually modified and preserves those edits when regenerating based on updated data or module definitions, showing modified vs unchanged segment counts.
caveats: Individual segments can be reverted to baseline if needed
Force regeneration overwrites all manual edits

features.name: Configuration package import
features.description: Allows importing existing Rapid Start configuration packages with up to 250 tables or more, automatically copying table selections, field selections, and filters into the demo data generator module definition.

features.name: Open source demo data generator
features.description: The demo data generator is open source, allowing partners and ISVs to extend it and contribute improvements back to the community, particularly for transactional data generation approaches.
